- Updated regulatory section in SKILL.md with the latest 2026-06 policy and regulatory developments, including NFRA directives, Basel III implementation, and AI/data security regulations.
- Added specific compliance notes on AI high-risk application scenarios, cybersecurity, and revised license management affecting bank credit memo requirements.
- Removed skill-card.md from the package.
- No changes to core report logic or credit memo structure; content enhancements focus on regulatory awareness and compliance documentation.

- Added a new section summarizing 2026 Q1 bank regulatory updates, including ESG disclosure and supply chain finance requirements.
- Memo template guidance updated to emphasize increased focus on ESG and supply chain finance modules in line with the latest regulations.
- Regulatory update table and latest policy references included at the start of the documentation.
- No changes to functionality or user prompts; changes improve awareness of banking compliance trends for users.

Version 4.0.0 introduces major metadata updates.

- Added slug and expanded keywords for improved searchability and discoverability.
- Enhanced description and keyword coverage to include more banking and credit assessment terms (e.g., 信贷审批, 贷款评估, 额度测算, 担保评估).
- No changes to the report logic, workflow, or credit memo structure.
- Maintains previous triggers and core functionality; update focuses on metadata and documentation clarity.

**Major update with new regulatory and industry framework support:**

- Added coverage of 2024–2026 Basel III risk weight framework.
- Introduced ESG/green credit assessment capabilities and new memo structure.
- Incorporated support for China real estate "whitelist" policy and digital supply chain finance scenarios.
- Enhanced description and keywords for improved discoverability and relevance.
- No changes to prompts or user flow; all core report templates remain, with added options for regulatory/green/group variants.
Initial release: AI-powered credit memo generator - financial analysis, internal rating, facility recommendation, and standard credit report generation
